outcome: Internalizing disorders (treatment for anxiety or mood disorders)
cohort: The study included 1,422,487 students graduating from the last year of Swedish compulsory school (school year 9, aged 16 years) between 2006 and 2018.
finding: The association between academic achievement and treatment for internalizing disorders strengthened over time among Swedish-born students, especially low-achieving girls, but was largely stable or diminished among immigrant students.
cross-section timing: Students in school year 9 (aged 16 years) between 2006 and 2018.
